messages:
anna_sales: Polaris POC asks for SOC 2 cert, pen-test attestation, and the delta for dedicated vs hosted (VPC). Delivery requested in ~48h. Any blockers?
eli_solutions: Do they want the full SOC2 package or just the public report + summary mapping? We usually provide SOC2.pdf + control_matrix.csv + pen_test_attestation.pdf as a starter. @jamie_security can we share via presigned S3 or their SFTP?
jamie_security: We can. Quick notes: full penetration report requires a signed NDA and redaction (customer-sensitive findings). We can provide a pen-test attestation letter signed by our security lead without the full report. Timeline: 24-72h depending on legal sign-off. Recommend we send SOC2 PDF + control mapping first.
frank_sales_engineer: Pricing note: Dedicated/reserved racks add ~30% run-rate vs hosted for their QPS; on-prem pricing is separate and higher (infra + install). For a POC we can offer a 2-week reserved trial (no commit) with a usage cap to emulate dedicated latency. I'll draft the numbers.
anna_sales: They also want to upload sample logs for us to reproduce an issue. Prefer a presigned S3 path. Suggest 7-day presign.
eli_solutions: Ok I'll create a presigned link. Suggested upload path and example command: 
```bash
# path: audit_uploads/polaris/POC_2026-03-23.zip
curl -X PUT -T polaris_sample.zip "${PRESIGNED_URL}"
```
Make sure we include a small redaction checklist in the message to customer.
jamie_security: Important: do NOT include customer PII or production keys in the uploaded file. We accept sanitized logs only. For KMS questions we can provide Key Custody diagram and rotation policy (pdf), but we cannot export customer-managed keys.
sofia_legal: Quick legal note on the pen-test letter: if the customer requires the full pen-test report signed/annotated to their format or letterhead, legal review is required and adds ~48h. For fastest turnaround we can supply our standard attestation signed by CISO. I'll queue review.
anna_sales: Can someone assemble a single zip with: SOC2.pdf, control_matrix.csv, pen_test_attestation.pdf, and the POC pricing sheet? I'll send to Polaris once packaged.
frank_sales_engineer: I'll populate the pricing_sheet with two rows: hosted (usage per token/qps) and dedicated (reserved + burst). Also include a POC note: 2-week reserved trial, 500k tokens cap. ETA EOD.
eli_solutions: I'll generate the presigned link, add the redaction checklist, and attach upload instructions. Will post link in the thread when ready.
jamie_security: :thumbsup: Preparing the attestation now. If legal flags anything I'll ping @sofia_legal.
audits-bot: New evidence request created: REQ-9872 (linked to Polaris POC).
